suggestions.pitch: A 2-4 rebuilding partner should accept Bigsby for Vidal and Okereke, two weekly starters worth about +73 points to my contending lineup.
Willis and Bigsby bring back Zay Flowers and Theo Johnson, both starters, for about +65 points.
Bigsby for Hunter Henry and DK Metcalf from a 1-5 team adds two starters for about +69 points.
